extracted.name: Vodka Paralyzer
extracted.description: A paralyzer is a creamy cocktail made with simple ingredients — cola, coffee liqueur, vodka, milk, and ice — for a boozy, milkshake-like drink.
instruction_lines: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Pour in cola, coffee liqueur, and vodka in the order listed; add milk and stir briefly. Top with a maraschino cherry.
